attributes.title: accept_proposal
attributes.description: Records that the user has approved the saved proposal, which unlocks the create_ tools. Call it ONLY when the user has clearly told you in the chat to go ahead and create the structure -- never on your own initiative, and never to get past a 'not_accepted' refusal. Creates nothing itself; follow it with the create_ calls.

parameters.name: proposal_id
parameters.description: Id returned by save_proposal. Omit to accept the most recent proposal.
